receiptContract.rootContract: root:wheel directory, mode 0711, no ACL, no extended attributes, never recursively removed by install rollback or revocation
receiptContract.memberContract: root:wheel regular file, mode 0444, link count 1, no ACL, no extended attributes, exact canonical JSON bytes
receiptContract.publication: Write a root-only temporary regular file in the receipt root, fsync it, atomically publish without replacement, fsync the directory, then reopen and validate exact bytes and filesystem facts. A SUCCESS receipt is published only after authorization; any receipt-publication failure removes authorization and the fresh namespace before publishing FAILURE.
receiptContract.collisionAndReplay: A pre-existing exact terminal receipt is validated and returned idempotently; any byte, schema, mode, owner, link, ACL, xattr, candidate, envelope, legacy-identity, or state disagreement fails closed. A FAILURE receipt permanently forbids reuse of the same artifact and handoff.
receiptContract.readContract: UID 501 and the independent reviewer may read only the known exact receipt path through traverse-only ancestors; directory enumeration and writes remain forbidden.
receiptContract.retention: Failure rollback and successful revocation retain the exact receipt. Revocation records its SHA-256 in the retained A04 evidence index and never modifies or deletes it.
